name: ai-testcase-agent
description: An autonomous AI agent (Claude + Playwright) that explores a web module, designs test cases, validates them in a real browser, self-heals broken ones, and emits Playwright specs plus manual test cases.
author: Satish Gullipalli

scripts.demo: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js generate --site demo-shop --module all --llm replay
scripts.render: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js render
